description: This file defines the interface for the IClientController and its accessor within the Rialto client namespace. It includes class declarations, method signatures, and references to external classes related to shared memory and control clients, serving as a contract for managing shared memory and client registration in the Rialto media client.

classes.name: IClientControllerAccessor
classes.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of IClientController and allows retrieval of the IClientController object.

classes.name: IClientController
classes.description: Defines the internal API for querying shared memory, registering, and unregistering clients.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of IClientControllerAccessor.

methods.name: getClientController
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton IClientController object.

methods.name: getSharedMemoryHandle
methods.description: Retrieves the shared memory handle as a shared pointer.

methods.name: registerClient
methods.description: Registers a client for shared buffer change notifications and updates the application state.

methods.name: unregisterClient
methods.description: Unregisters a client from shared memory notifications.
